標題： 【轉知】國立臺灣師範大學❌雄獅全球人才計畫-哈伯造星 第3梯次研習營開始報名囉!!
日期： Fri, 21 Feb 2025 14:38:32 +0800
附檔： 臺師大ｘ雄獅全球人才計畫_哈伯造星DM.jpg (2 MB)   
由雄獅旅遊集團與國立臺灣師範大學，聯手推出《哈伯造星》全球人才培育計畫，為你鋪向直達國際職場的快車道！一個難得《海外實習》及《儲備幹部》機會！

💖3秒告訴你為什麼這是你夢寐以求的實習機會：
•海外實習+ 國內研習營，技能全方位升級！
•實習期間月薪3 萬，還有機票住宿全包！
•加入雄獅儲備幹部，開啟職涯快速通道！
•正式入職儲備幹部薪資4萬-4萬5
💖不只是實習，而是一場職場大冒險！
•雄獅總部研習營：快速提升專業技能
•儲備幹部：開啟職涯全方位訓練
•國內實習：深入了解旅行業領導品牌之經營
•海外實習：累積跨國實務經驗

第一梯入選同學分別來自：臺大、政大、臺師大、文化、高雄科大、屏東大學、臺北教育大學
第二梯入選同學分別來自：臺大、政大、臺師大、中山大、中央大、台藝大、逢甲大學
第三梯次海外實習將展開《預計前往：東京、上海、廣州、曼谷》，同學們可以參考以下連結，把握海外實習的學習機會！
現在就行動，下一個職場新星就是你！
👉️立即報名：https://forms.gle/g43hMgZ7CVg3aZ5w6

Hello Everyone! 
Here's an incredible opportunity for an Overseas Internship and Management Associate (MA) Program!
In collaboration with Lion Travel Group (the largest travel group in Taiwan with nearly 3000 employees globally) and National Taiwan Normal University, we proudly present the Hubble Project for Global Talents, your fast track to the international job market!
What makes this internship the perfect opportunity for you? (Let me use 3 seconds to convince you)
•Guarantee One-month overseas internship with salary and free airfare and free accommodation!
•Fast-track career path as a MA at Lion Travel Group!
•Official starting salary as a MA: NT$40,000 - NT$45,000!
•More than just an internship—it’s a career adventure!
What’s included in the program?
•8 days free training camp at the headquarters of Lion Travel Group—rapidly enhance your professional skills
•MA Program—comprehensive career training
•Domestic Internship—gain insights into the operations of a leading travel brand
•Overseas Internship—build valuable cross-border work experience
Where are our previous candidates from?
First cohort: National Taiwan University, National Chengchi University, National Taiwan Normal University, Chinese Culture University, National Kaohsiung University of Science and Technology, National Pingtung University, National Taipei University of Education
Second cohort: National Taiwan University, National Chengchi University, National Taiwan Normal University, National Sun Yat-sen University, National Central University, National Taiwan University of Arts, Feng Chia University
Upcoming Third Cohort Destinations:
🌏️ Tokyo | Shanghai | Guangzhou | Bangkok
